Lenovo LOQ 15IRX9 Gaming Laptop - Intel Core i5-13450HX - RTX 3050 6gb - 24GB RAM

Experience next-level gaming and heavy rendering performance with the Lenovo LOQ 15IRX9, proudly offered by Turbo Computer Egypt. Built with a military-grade chassis in sleek Luna Grey, this machine features an advanced Intel Core i5-13450HX processor paired with a massive 24GB of high-speed system memory and NVIDIA RTX 3050 graphics. Engineered with Lenovo's hyperchamber thermal design for quiet and uncompromised performance under maximum load. Includes an official 2-year agent warranty across Egypt.
